name: Moo Times of Betsy
source:
Moo Times of Betsy follows the adventures of a plush cow animal named Betsy as she contemplates about life in an udderly fashion.

[From [url=https://redlotusdesignz.itch.io/mootimesofbetsy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《贝特西的哞哞时代》讲述了一只名叫贝特西的毛绒奶牛的冒险故事，她以一种乳房的方式思考生活。

[来自[url=https://redlotusdesignz.itch.io/mootimesofbetsy]itch.io[/url]]
